1934, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK. NO. 5.
Page 228 Cont.
Mrs. Emma Demere - 50 - of Fraser, Mich. - cancer on face. ....
Sep. Mrs. Mary + Peters - 79 - Heart-atack last Xmas-time - then came cancer on hand. Cured in both cases - stroke last Friday .... died Monday a.m. - Mother of 23 Child. - golden wedding ten yrs. ago - Husband now 88 - prayers.
Percy A. Kempt - about 55 - "nothing" - wife ridicules idea of praying for cure - no liquid in Eyes - blind ..
Blank Page
Page 229 Page 230 Sep. 18 Mrs. Mary Hobib - 43 - fears operation - member of 3rd Order - waiting till after convention (Sunday - Monday)
John Kauffman - Anniv. To-morrow - burned to death under sad cir- cumstance - prayers for victims requested.
Michael Birg - 29 - threatining throat trouble for 6 mos.
18 Neil SinClair - 62 - raised presbiterian Family all Catholic. Went to Grace Hosp. this evening for operation in colon to-morrow. Enrolled.
Lazarito Congutello - 48 - very poorly fears cancer of stomach.
Blank Page
Page 231 Page 232 Sep. Bernadett M. Edwards - 11 - weak-heart asthma ... misses much school Charles Jos. Schaefer - 46 - doctoring ... don't know what the trouble .... Trouble - married out of Church 14 yrs ...... Macy Case - John Dums - 38 - worrying to insanity? .. wife & 4 depending Gerald McGraw - 9 - diabetis
Mr. Tho's Plunket - 44 - drinking Mr. Archie Hank - 40 - govnment contracter - struggling to continue honest & charitable ....
